Support: up to 35 photos per post in the app. API: JPEG or WebP, max 1080p, 20 MB per image, up to 35 image URLs, title max 90 and description max 4,000 UTF-16 characters. No official aspect ratio for photo posts was found.

Safe area for text and logos at minimum size: 1235x338 px. Same banner is used on computer, mobile and TV but is cropped differently. No borders, shadows or frames. Banner file types are not listed on the help page.
